newsitem.title: USA: Owosso Corp acquires Koepke and Associates.
newsitem.headline: Owosso Corp acquires Koepke and Associates.

text.p: Owosso Corp said on Monday it acquired Koepke and Associates, a Northfield, Illinois-based manufacturer's representative company.
Koepke and Associates will be renamed Owosso Motor Group and will act as the sales and marketing arm of Owosso's fractional horsepower motor and gear motor subsidiaries.
Owosso said it will issue 75,000 shares of its common stock in exchange for all of the stock of Koepke and Associates.
